app.name: KaamPass
app.introduction: A trusted work profile for skills, agreements and verified job history.

auth.switchToLogin: Already have an account? Sign in

home.title: Carry your work history forward.
home.intro: Build a professional profile for your trade, then turn agreed work into verified experience.
home.signedInIntro: Your account is ready. Open your profile or continue to jobs.
home.statusHelp: KaamPass checks the API before account and profile requests.

gates.profileTitle: Sign in to view your profile.
gates.profileBody: Your professional and account details are private until you sign in.
gates.jobsTitle: Sign in to view your jobs.
gates.jobsBody: Agreements and job details are only available to their participants.

jobs.title: Jobs are the next step.
jobs.empty: Agreement creation, worker responses and active jobs will be added in Module 3. Your profile is ready for that workflow.

history.title: Verified work history
history.privateHint: Only you can see payment details. Verified means both people confirmed the work and payment.
history.repeatHint: A repeat employer has confirmed two or more jobs with you.
history.empty: Your confirmed jobs will appear here.

completion.employerHint: Record the actual days worked and amount already paid. The worker must confirm both.
completion.workerHint: Confirm only if the work and payment shown above are correct. Confirmation creates a verified work record.

errors.invalid: Enter 1–365 days and a valid payment amount with up to two decimal places.
errors.changed: This job has already changed. Refresh the page and review its status.
errors.session: Your session expired. Sign in again.
errors.save: Could not save your response. Check your connection and try again.

agreements.employerTitle: Set clear terms before work starts.
agreements.workerTitle: Review every term before you respond.
agreements.employerIntro: Choose a worker, describe the work and send one clear price, duration and materials agreement.
agreements.workerIntro: Only you can accept or reject agreements sent to your worker profile.
agreements.directIntro: Use this when you already know who should receive the agreement.
agreements.createIntro: The calculated total is saved by the server as the canonical amount.
agreements.noActiveJobs: No active jobs yet. An accepted agreement starts a job.
agreements.noWorkers: No completed worker profiles are available yet.

errors.invalid: Check the worker, description, days, price and profession-specific details.

errors.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Sign in again before continuing.
errors.profileRequired: Complete your employer profile before sending an agreement.
errors.alreadyResponded: This agreement was already accepted or rejected. Reload to see its latest status.
errors.notFound: This agreement is unavailable or does not belong to your account.

marketplace.employerTitle: Post the problem and compare real bids.
marketplace.workerTitle: Find work that matches your profession.
marketplace.employerIntro: Relevant workers can review the request, quote their price and estimated days, and let you compare their KaamPass profiles.
marketplace.workerIntro: Only work requests matching your saved profession appear here. You can submit one bid for each request.
marketplace.postHelp: Use a broad service area. Do not include a phone number, exact address, or other private contact details.
marketplace.title: Short title
marketplace.description: Describe the problem and expected result
marketplace.imageHelp: {{count}} of 3 selected. JPEG, PNG or WebP; maximum 5 MB each. Avoid faces, addresses and private documents.
marketplace.noEmployerPosts: You have not posted any work requests yet.
marketplace.noWorkerPosts: No open work requests currently match your profession.

errors.invalidPost: Check the title, profession, area, description and trade details.
errors.invalidBid: Enter a valid price and estimated number of days.
errors.loadFailed: Work requests could not be loaded. Check the API and try again.
errors.saveFailed: The marketplace change was not saved. Try again.
errors.network: The marketplace service could not be reached.
errors.profileRequired: Complete the correct employer or worker profile before continuing.
errors.bidExists: You already submitted a bid for this request.
errors.professionMismatch: This request does not match your saved profession.
errors.closed: This request or bid was already resolved. Reload to see the latest status.
errors.invalidImages: Choose no more than three JPEG, PNG or WebP images, each under 5 MB.
errors.selectionFailed: The worker could not be selected. No agreement was created.
